label: Pilot neighborhood

shared_facts.text: Walt has received a serious medical diagnosis he has not fully shared with the household.
shared_facts.text_zh: 沃尔特收到了严重的医学诊断，还没有完整告诉家里。

shared_facts.text: Walt and Jesse have begun a dangerous partnership outside normal life.
shared_facts.text_zh: 沃尔特和杰西已经在正常生活之外开始危险的合伙。

shared_facts.text: Walt carries a deep pride wound about lost scientific success and status.
shared_facts.text_zh: 沃尔特对失去的科学成就与地位，带着很深的自尊伤口。

open_tensions.text: Walt wants control and money without losing the household story; Skyler senses cracks.
open_tensions.text_zh: 沃尔特想要掌控与金钱，又不想失去家里的体面故事；斯凯勒已经察觉裂缝。

open_tensions.text: Walt wants obedience dressed as partnership; Jesse wants respect and not to be disposable.
open_tensions.text_zh: 沃尔特要的是包装成合伙的服从；杰西要的是尊重，而不是被当工具。

label_zh: 第一季早期：教学、诊断与第一次越界
